sources.title: Kimi K3 official model card
sources.evidence: Identifies Kimi K3, released weights and custom license. Summary reports rounded 2.8T total / 104B active, MoE, 1,048,576 context, and hybrid KDA/Gated MLA. Usage explicitly requires thinking and preserved reasoning/tool-call messages; introduction includes image and video understanding.

sources.title: Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence, technical report (27 July 2026)
sources.evidence: Table 1 specifically labels Kimi K3 as 2.78T total and 104.2B activated parameters, with 93 layers, 69 KDA plus 24 MLA, 896 routed experts, 16 selected and two shared. Section 2.4 describes shared image/video vision encoding. Table lists one MTP layer.

sources.title: Kimi Code release history: Kimi K3, July 16, 2026
sources.evidence: Explicit dated Kimi K3 release entry on July 16, 2026 establishes public availability in Kimi Code. Its separate October 23 entry concerns K3.1 Pro.

sources.title: Kimi K3 License
sources.evidence: License names Kimi K3 License and Moonshot AI copyright; applies to model weights, parameters, code and configuration. It grants use and redistribution subject to conditions, including a separate commercial agreement for qualifying Model-as-a-Service businesses.

sources.title: Released Kimi K3 configuration
sources.evidence: KimiK3ForConditionalGeneration contains KimiLinear text and vision configurations. Confirms max_position_embeddings=1048576, 93 layers, 896 experts, 16 selected, two shared, and KDA/full-attention layer lists. Uses compressed-tensors mxfp4-pack-quantized weights and uint8 scales. num_nextn_predict_layers is 0.

sources.title: Kimi K3 API quickstart
sources.evidence: Exact kimi-k3 API examples document final text responses, vision input, tools, tool_choice, returned tool_calls and tool-result continuation. K3 always thinks, with low/high/max reasoning_effort. Full weights are released; K3 is explicitly described as the previous-generation flagship.

sources.title: Kimi Code model configuration and routing
sources.evidence: Separate columns distinguish K3, K3-256K and K3.1 Pro. K3 supports 1048576 tokens plus image/video input. Turning thinking off for K3 routes to K2.8 Preview without thinking; it does not establish a non-reasoning K3 variant.

sources.title: Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence launch blog
sources.evidence: Launch announces K3 available through products and API, with full weights planned by July 27, 2026. Establishes native vision, KDA, Attention Residuals, Stable LatentMoE and coding/knowledge/reasoning applications. Initial max effort was followed by lower effort options.

sources.title: Introducing Kimi K3.1 Pro
sources.evidence: Later first-party announcement explicitly identifies K3.1 Pro as a post-trained version of Kimi K3. Its new-series rollout and planned November 4 weight release concern the sibling, not the audited K3 checkpoint.

name.note: Official model and launch names agree.

developer.note: Official publishing account and copyright identify Moonshot AI.

family.note: Normalized K3 family identifier; later K3.1 Pro is a separately named post-trained sibling.

release_date.note: Explicit public K3 release date. July 27 concerns subsequent weights/report availability, not earliest public release.

open_weights.note: Official model repository distributes weights and the API guide confirms release; conditional licensing does not make weights unavailable.

license.note: Named custom license covering the weights; do not substitute MIT or an unrestricted open-source claim.

parameters_b.note: Table 1 gives 2.78T = 2780B nominal total, more precise than rounded 2.8T. This is a published count, not an exact checkpoint tensor census.

active_parameters_b.note: Table 1 independently reports 104.2B activated parameters; card rounds to 104B. Not estimated by multiplying total by expert routing fraction.

architecture.note: Stable LatentMoE with hybrid KDA/Gated MLA attention and Attention Residuals. It is not a conventional dense Transformer.

context_window.note: Exact card/configuration value; Kimi Code tier caps and K3-256K are separate service restrictions.

modalities.note: Native image/video encoding accompanies text input; API generates reasoning and final text, including tool-call structures.

reasoning.note: Dedicated reasoning model with always-on thinking and adjustable effort. The Kimi Code thinking-disabled fallback is K2.8 Preview, not non-reasoning K3.

tool_call.note: Exact kimi-k3 examples pass function definitions and consume returned tool_calls with tool-result continuation.

description.value: Open-weight multimodal MoE model with hybrid KDA/MLA attention, a 1,048,576-token context window, always-on reasoning, and tool calling.
description.note: Replaces misleading toggleable-thinking wording with documented model capabilities; avoids unverified performance rankings.

patch.description: Open-weight multimodal MoE model with hybrid KDA/MLA attention, a 1,048,576-token context window, always-on reasoning, and tool calling.
patch.notes: Counts follow technical-report Table 1 nominal precision. That table lists one MTP layer, while released config sets num_nextn_predict_layers=0; no exact checkpoint-wide count is claimed. Packed MXFP4 storage and scale tensors are not learned-parameter counts. K3 always reasons; disabling thinking in Kimi Code routes to K2.8 Preview.

summary: All 14 fields verified. Adds nominal total/active counts, MoE architecture and the custom license; corrects toggleable thinking. Public release remains July 16. K3.1 Pro and its future weight release were not conflated with K3.
